# Security Policy

This repository is one person's dotfiles: shell start-up, small command-line
tools and configuration. There are no releases, so only the current `master`
branch is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report a vulnerability privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting][pvr] — the **Report a vulnerability**
button on this repository's **Security** tab. Please do not open a public
issue for a security problem.

Include what is affected (a file or script), how to reproduce it, and what
an attacker could do with it. This is a personal project maintained by one
person, so expect a reply on a best-effort basis rather than to a fixed
schedule.

[pvr]: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability
